name: 무명장수
weapon: Korean deungpae large convex dark rattan round shield, blackened iron rim, octagonal iron central boss engraved with a faint turquoise circle, three worn red knots; paired short broad single edged Korean yodo saber with black grip. The shield is the dominant item and the saber secondary.
body: A scarred middle-aged Korean male general, broad sturdy shoulders and heavy legs, black hair tied in a short topknot, short stern facial hair. Worn charcoal iron Joseon lamellar armour with dark brown bindings and a restrained muted turquoise sash. Holds a large convex round rattan deungpae shield in his LEFT hand (viewer right) covering his chest to upper thighs, with a short single-edged yodo saber held lowered in his RIGHT hand (viewer left), blade not crossing his face. The shield must read as dark woven wood with a black iron rim and a small turquoise octagonal boss, not a European heraldic shield.
color: iron grey, dark rattan brown, muted turquoise
frontReferencePolicy: The final front PNG defines identity and actual equipment placement; preserve it for future south-reference rotations. Do not mirror asymmetric equipment.
